name: metric-review
title: Metric review working paper
for_each: SELECT id,code FROM metrics ORDER BY code

sections.title: Monthly results
sections.sql: SELECT period,segment,actual,target,variance,status FROM v_scorecard WHERE metric_id=$1 ORDER BY period,segment

sections.title: Review actions
sections.sql: SELECT code,title,owner,due_on,status,resolution FROM actions WHERE metric_id=$1 ORDER BY due_on

sections.title: Decisions
sections.sql: SELECT actor,event,detail,created_at FROM events WHERE metric_id=$1 ORDER BY created_at

name: action-brief
title: Performance action brief
for_each: SELECT id,code FROM actions ORDER BY code

sections.title: Action and evidence
sections.sql: SELECT a.code,a.title,a.owner,a.due_on,a.status,a.resolution,m.code metric,m.definition FROM actions a JOIN metrics m ON m.id=a.metric_id WHERE a.id=$1
